name: VR SETKA 3
summary: VR SETKA 3 is a grid trading EA that places a series of pending orders at fixed price intervals, creating a grid of positions around the current price. It manages the grid by adjusting order levels and lot sizes as the market moves, aiming to profit from price oscillations within the grid range. The EA uses a systematic grid placement strategy without a primary trend filter, relying on market volatility to generate profit through multiple small trades.
summary_zh: VR SETKA 3是一个网格交易EA，在当前价格周围按固定间隔放置一系列挂单，形成网格仓位。它随着市场移动调整订单级别和手数，旨在通过价格在网格范围内的震荡获利。该EA使用系统化的网格布局策略，没有主趋势过滤器，依靠市场波动性通过多个小交易产生利润。
strategy_analysis: VR SETKA 3的核心策略是网格交易，通过在当前价格上下方按固定间隔布置买入和卖出挂单来构建交易网格。入场条件基于预设的价格间隔和网格步长，当价格触及某个网格级别时自动开仓。出场条件通常依赖整体网格的盈利目标，当所有持仓的净盈利达到设定值时全部平仓。仓位管理采用网格层级递增的方式，部分变体可能使用马丁格尔式的手数递增。资金管理通过设置最大网格层数和总仓位限制来控制风险，但在强趋势行情中网格可能被突破导致较大浮亏。该策略适合震荡行情，在单边趋势中风险较高。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of VR SETKA 3 is grid trading, constructing a trading grid by placing buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price. Entry conditions are based on preset price intervals and grid step sizes, automatically opening positions when price reaches a grid level. Exit conditions typically rely on an overall grid profit target, closing all positions when the net profit of all holdings reaches a set value. Position sizing uses grid-level incremental sizing, with some variants potentially employing Martingale-style lot size escalation. Money management controls risk by setting maximum grid levels and total position limits, but the grid can be breached during strong trending markets resulting in significant floating losses. This strategy is suitable for ranging markets but carries high risk during unidirectional trends.

parameters.name: GridStep
parameters.description: 网格步长（点数），相邻挂单之间的价格间隔
parameters.description_en: Grid step (points), price interval between pending orders

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 初始手数，第一层网格的开仓量

parameters.name: MaxOrders
parameters.description: 最大挂单数量，限制网格的最大层数
parameters.description_en: Maximum pending orders, limits grid layers

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 整体止盈金额，当网格总盈利达到此值时全部平仓
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

parameters.name: LotMultiplier
parameters.description: 手数乘数，每层网格手数递增倍率
parameters.description_en: Lot multiplier, incremental ratio per grid layer

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损金额，0表示不设整体止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

pros: 网格策略在震荡行情中表现优异，能持续从小幅波动中获利
系统化执行消除情绪干扰，交易规则明确无歧义
通过多层级挂单分散入场价格，降低单一入场点的风险
参数可调性强，交易者可根据市场波动率调整网格间距和手数
整体止盈机制确保锁定利润，不会因贪婪错过平仓时机
pros_en: Grid strategy performs excellently in ranging markets, continuously profiting from small price oscillations
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference with clear unambiguous trading rules
Multi-level pending ordersdisperse entry prices, reducing risk at any single entry point
Highly adjustable parameters allow traders to customize grid spacing and lot sizes based on market volatility
Overall take-profit mechanism ensures profit locking, preventing missed exit opportunities due to greed
cons: 在强单边趋势行情中网格可能被持续突破，导致浮亏不断累积
若LotMultiplier大于1则存在马丁格尔风险，亏损时手数指数增长
默认止损为0意味着没有硬性风控底线，极端行情可能爆仓
网格策略占用保证金较大，多层挂单对账户资金要求高
缺乏趋势过滤器，在趋势行情中仍会不断逆势加仓
cons_en: Grid can be continuously breached during strong trending markets, causing accumulated floating losses
LotMultiplier greater than 1 introduces Martingale risk with exponentially increasing lot sizes on losses
Default stop loss of 0 means no hard risk control floor, potentially leading to account blowup in extreme markets
Grid strategy requires significant margin, multi-level pending orders demand high account capital
Lacks a trend filter, continuously adding counter-trend positions during trending markets
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），在强趋势行情中暂停或减少网格开仓
设置强制整体止损，防止单边极端行情下的无限浮亏
加入波动率自适应机制，根据ATR动态调整网格步长
限制最大浮亏比例，当账户净值回撤超过阈值时自动全部平仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction or ADX indicator) to pause or reduce grid opening during strong trends
Implement a mandatory overall stop loss to prevent unlimited floating losses in extreme one-way markets
Add volatility-adaptive mechanism to dynamically adjust grid step size based on ATR
Limit maximum floating loss ratio, automatically closing all positions when account equity drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 网格策略在单边趋势中浮亏可无限扩大，默认无止损极其危险
手数递增乘数使持仓手数呈指数增长，极端行情下可能导致爆仓
缺乏趋势识别和波动率过滤，在不利行情中持续逆势加仓
多层挂单占用大量保证金，在极端波动中可能触发强制平仓
risk_points_en: Grid strategy can lead to unlimited floating losses in one-way trends, default no stop loss is extremely dangerous
Lot multiplication causes exponential position size growth, potentially leading to account blowup in extreme markets
Lacks trend identification and volatility filtering, continuously adding counter-trend positions in adverse markets
Multi-level pending orders occupy significant margin, potentially triggering forced liquidation during extreme volatility

It manages the grid by adjusting order levels and lot sizes as the market moves, aiming to profit from price oscillations within the grid range. The EA uses a systematic grid placement strategy without a primary trend filter, relying on market volatility to generate profit through multiple small trades.
